#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

void process(const std::string& a, std::ostream& out) {
    int index = 0;
    int maxLength = 0;
    int pairCount = 0;
    bool inParentheses = false;
    int n = a.length();

    while (index < n) {
        if (a[index] == '(') {
            inParentheses = true;
        } else if (a[index] == ')') {
            inParentheses = false;
        } else if (isalpha(a[index])) {
            index--;
        }
        if (inParentheses) {
            while (++index != n && a[index] != ')' && !isalpha(a[index]));
            if (index == n || !isalpha(a[index])) {
                continue;
            }
            while (isalpha(a[++index]));
            pairCount++;
        } else {
            while (++index != n && a[index] != '(' && !isalpha(a[index]));
            if (index == n || !isalpha(a[index])) {
                continue;
            }
            int startIdx = index;
            while (++index != n && isalpha(a[index]));
            maxLength = std::max(maxLength, index - startIdx);
        }
    }
    out << maxLength << " " << pairCount << "\n";
}

int main() {
    std::string line;
    // Read and ignore the first line
    std::getline(std::cin, line);
    // Read the second line for processing
    std::getline(std::cin, line);
    process(line, std::cout);
    return 0;
}
